kana: まかぬたねははえぬ
meanings: if you don't put in the effort, don't expect results
seeds you don't plant will never grow

japanese: 鹿を追う者は山を見ず
kana: しかをおうものはやまをみず
meanings: zeal is a bad servant
the person who chases a deer does not see the mountain

japanese: 捨てる神あれば拾う神あり
kana: すてるかみあればひろうかみあり
meanings: when one door is shut, another is open
the world is as kind as it is cruel

kana: しゃじくをながす
meanings: to rain heavily
to be raining cats and dogs

kana: じゃのみちはへび
meanings: the wolf knows what the ill beast thinks
it takes one to know one

japanese: 弱き者よ汝の名は女なり
kana: よわきものよなんじのなはおんななり
meanings: frailty, thy name is woman

japanese: 朱に交われば赤くなる
kana: しゅにまじわればあかくなる
meanings: people will take on the characteristics of those who surround them
spend time with the wise and you will become wise, but the friends of fools will suffer

kana: さけはひゃくやくのちょう
meanings: good wine makes good blood
sake is the best of all medicines

japanese: 終わりよければすべてよし
kana: おわりよければすべてよし
meanings: all's well that ends well
it will all come good in the end

kana: ならいせいとなる
meanings: habit is a second nature

kana: でものはれものところきらわず
meanings: when you've got to go, you've got to go
farts and boils aren't choosy about where (or when) to appear

kana: たてのりょうめんをみよ
meanings: look at both sides of the thing
look at both sides of the shield

kana: しょしんわするべからず
meanings: we were all beginners once
never lose your humility

kana: ところかわればしなかわる
meanings: so many countries, so many customs

kana: あつささむさもひがんまで
meanings: no heat or cold lasts over the equinox

kana: おんなのいちねんいわをもとおす
meanings: women will have their wills

japanese: 女の髪の毛には大象も繋がる
kana: おんなのかみのけにはたいぞうもつながる
meanings: no man can resist the lure of a woman

japanese: 女は弱しされど母は強し
kana: おんなはよわしされどはははつよし
meanings: though the woman is weak, the mother is strong

kana: おんなさんにんよればかしまし
meanings: three women make a market

japanese: 将を射んと欲すれば先ず馬を射よ
kana: しょうをいんとほっすればまずうまをいよ
meanings: do not shoot straight for the top
he that would the daughter win, must with the mother first begin

japanese: 小の虫を殺して大の虫を生かす
kana: しょうのむしをころしてだいのむしをいかす
meanings: to sacrifice something small in order to save something great
to lose a leg to save one's life

kana: しょうじはだいじ
meanings: a small leak can sink a great ship

japanese: 小人閑居して不善をなす
kana: しょうじんかんきょしてふぜんをなす
meanings: an idle brain is the devil's shop

japanese: 焼けぼっくいに火がつく
kana: やけぼっくいにひがつく
meanings: the embers of a former relationship flare up again
old love blazes anew

kana: しょうもんのだしおくれ
meanings: something done too late
